theory.aim: To analyze student academic performance using descriptive statistics.
theory.description: This experiment helps students understand how raw academic data can be analyzed using basic statistical measures such as mean and percentage. The experiment is aligned with VTU 3rd semester Data Science syllabus and introduces students to data-driven decision making.
procedure: Collect marks of a student in three subjects.
Classify the result as Pass or Fail based on VTU criteria.
Interpret the performance level of the student.
applications: Foundation for predictive analytics and machine learning

diagnostics.message: Poor performance. Student requires academic support.
Good performance. Student is doing well.

viva: Why is mean used in data analysis?
How can this experiment be extended using machine learning?
